verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents configurable, event-driven behaviors in .coderabbit.yaml. Reviews fire automatically when a PR opens, gated by keyword, label, branch, draft status and commit count (auto_review). The request-changes workflow automatically requests changes or approves a PR based on review outcomes. CI failures automatically produce inline fix comments. These are fixed, predefined actions with configurable conditions, not a general user-defined rule engine that maps arbitrary events to arbitrary actions. Missing for 10: a general-purpose event→action rule builder, custom triggers beyond the PR-review lifecycle, documented examples of user-authored automation recipes firing on events, and independent hands-on corroboration.
